entries.desc: 在未依赖 dist 模块的源码 fallback 路径下运行 npm run test:process-fact-contract，不再因 DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS 的 * key 生成无效正则而崩溃。

evidence.note: process-fact contract passed and printed Process fact contract verified; source fallback parser handles DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS star key without invalid regex.

entries.desc: 源码 fallback 同时能解析 * 全局工具列表和 REVIEW/DEV 等普通 phase 工具列表，并保留现有 policy/default alignment 检查。

evidence.note: contract synthetic parser checks cover star global tools and DEV/REVIEW phase tool parsing while preserving policy/default alignment checks.

entries.desc: synthetic config 中包含 * key、注释和字符串时，phase tool parser 不把 * 当正则特殊字符，也不会误读注释里的命令。

evidence.note: synthetic DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS fixture includes star key, ordinary phase keys, comments, and strings; commented commands are not parsed.

entries.desc: 维护者打开 process-fact registry 时能看到 command lifecycle、process fact level、phase/rootOnly、producer、consumer gate、artifact/signature 等核心事实集中登记。

evidence.note: process-fact-registry.ts exposes PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY plus kind, level, lifecycle, allowedPhases, rootOnly, destructiveRisk, producer, consumerGate, artifact, signature, and reviewerLane fields.

entries.desc: 第一版 registry 与现有 COMMAND_POLICIES/PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS 能保持兼容，旧 runtime 行为不因 registry 引入而改变。

evidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:process-fact-contract
evidence.note: registry is derived from COMMAND_POLICIES and PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS; build and contract pass without changing runtime command policy behavior.

entries.desc: 新增 MAIN_TOOLS 命令但未在 registry 登记时，contract verifier 明确失败并点名缺失命令。

evidence.note: contract checks every MAIN_TOOLS command has a PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY command fact and reports missing commands as MAIN_TOOLS command missing from PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY.

entries.desc: process-fact contract 通过时输出 Process fact contract verified，并证明 registry、COMMAND_POLICIES、PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS、DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS、reviewer lane 和 signed artifacts 对齐。

evidence.note: contract printed Process fact contract verified and listed aligned registry entries for commands, policies, phase tools, reviewer lanes, and artifacts.

entries.desc: 项目 phaseTools 配置或 malformed config 不能放宽 legacy/rootOnly/gateEvidence，runtime probe 和 contract 都覆盖这一点。

evidence.note: contract includes runtime phaseTools config narrowing probe: legacy/rootOnly commands cannot be widened while policy-approved gate evidence remains allowed.

entries.desc: 人为制造 registry 与 phase/gate/artifact/reviewer lane 的不一致时，contract 输出具体 drift 信息而不是静默通过或崩溃。

evidence.note: contract now emits specific drift diagnostics such as missing from PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY, required process fact missing, reviewer lane missing, artifact missing, policy drift, and DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS phase allowlist drift.

entries.desc: registry 明确登记 validate/test evidence/verificationEvidence 代表的执行验证状态，以及 review_pass_set/finding_add 代表的 reviewer 结论事实。

evidence.note: registry declares validate validation-status, verification_evidence_* verification/execution evidence, review_pass_set review-pass/no-blocker evidence, and finding_* finding/blocker state semantics.

entries.desc: review_pass_set 作为 no-blocker evidence 被 registry 标记为 gate-consumed fact，pass-only finding_add 转换逻辑仍由 handler 硬兜底。

evidence.note: review_pass_set is registered as review-pass no-blocker gate evidence, and existing contract still checks pass-only finding_add prompt/handler protocol.

entries.desc: 删除 review_pass_set 或 validate 的 registry fact 时，contract verifier 失败并点名缺失 review/validation fact。

evidence.note: contract required semantic checks fail with required process fact missing or required semantic fact missing if review_pass_set, validate, or required evidence/finding facts are removed from registry.
